At high pressures, volume of gas being low and thus $\dfrac{a}{{V}_{m^{2}}}$ can be neglected. Thus, $\text{p} \left(\text{V} - \text{b}\right) = \text{RT}$

$\text{pV} = \text{RT} + \text{pb}$

$∴$Compressibility factor

$\text{Z} = \dfrac{\text{pV}}{\text{RT}} = 1 + \dfrac{\text{pb}}{\text{RT}}$

questions.solution:
RMS speed& $= \sqrt{\dfrac{3RT}{M}}$, Inversely proportional to the molar mass and directly proportional to the temperature.

$\dfrac{u1}{u2} = \sqrt{\dfrac{{n}_{1}{T}_{1}}{{n}_{2}{T}_{2}}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{n \times T}{2n \times 2T}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{1}{4}} = \dfrac{1}{2}$
